fields.summary_ko.0: Applied Materials (NASDAQ: AMAT) is trading at $381.01, down 29% over one month but up 49% year-to-date, with earnings release on November 12 serving as a catalyst for recovery or further decline.
fields.summary_ko.1: The company has set 2030 targets for non-GAAP gross margin of 54% and operating margin of 40%, and plans to expand WFE market share by 2% or more, with service revenue targeting over $12B by 2030.
